title: Billing and Coding: KidneyIntelX and KidneyIntelX.dkd Testing

covered.1: The Type 2 diabetes (T2D) ICD-10-CM code in Group1 below must be submitted with one ICD-10-CM code that indicates early-stage chronic kidney disease (CKD) (stages 1-3b) in Group 2.

noncovered.1: Any ICD-10-CM code not listed as required above.
